narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as a multi-front conflict intensifies: US-Iran kinetic exchanges, Israel-Hezbollah escalation, and deep Ukraine strikes on Russian infrastructure. The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline and the Apache shootdown confirm that diplomatic off-ramps are failing, driving a structural risk premium into commodities and safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil and short S&P 500 futures; overweight gold and short-dated US Treasuries as hedges against further escalation.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Divergence
narratives.summary: Despite BTC's macro-driven selloff, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure are accelerating: MicroStrategy buying the dip, Janus Henderson partnering with Ethena for tokenized CLOs, and retail dip-buying signal that capital is rotating into crypto as a long-term store of value separate from traditional risk assets.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate BTC on weakness via spot ETFs; long ENA token on the Janus Henderson partnership catalyst.

narratives.title: Sticky Inflation Resurgence Risk
narratives.summary: The housing market beat (+3.2% MoM vs +1.1% expected) contradicts the Fed's softening narrative, implying persistent inflation pressures. Combined with the Hormuz blockade driving energy costs higher, capital is pricing in a higher-for-longer Fed stance, which is negative for duration-sensitive assets and growth equities.
narratives.trade_implication: Short long-dated US Treasuries (TLT) and long breakeven inflation swaps; underweight consumer discretionary equities.
